notes: Fixed-frequency single-JJ transmons (r3). f01 targets are user inputs (3.5-4.4 GHz, ~300 MHz steps, 2026-11-23); the qubit-resonator pairing is a layout choice (lowest qubit on the lowest readout resonator) to keep the detuning near 2.5-2.8 GHz. Lj = (Phi0/2pi)^2 / EJ is the corresponding HFSS lumped input. Junction widths from code/qubit/jj_resistance_model.py (80 nm finger, RA = 625 Ohm um^2; uncalibrated estimate).
